title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Job type: Full-time We are Zenith are working with our client who are recruiting for multiple Customer Service Vacancies due to start ASAP. You ll support customers when something goes wrong at home from broken boilers to burst pipes helping them get fast, reliable assistance when they need it most. We re looking for self-motivated people who learn quickly, take ownership and are confident working in a busy call-centre environment. Duties & Responsibilities - Take inbound and make outbound calls, with no cold calling. - Log claims accurately and arrange engineer visits. - Keep customers updated and help ensure repairs progress efficiently. - Recognise when customers need additional support and respond with care. - Work with colleagues, clients and engineers to deliver excellent customer service. The People & Experience we are looking for - A self-motivated approach and the ability to learn new systems and processes quickly. - A positive, helpful attitude and a willingness to take ownership. - Strong communication skills and attention to detail. - Confidence using computers and managing several tasks at once. - Reliability, flexibility and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. - Availability to work the full rotating shift pattern, including weekends. - Commitment to attending and completing all mandatory training. Hours and shift pattern - Full-time role with a four-day working week. - Shifts follow a 12-week rotating pattern across all seven days, including Saturdays and Sundays. This is not a Monday-to-Friday role. - During summer, you ll work a combination of eight-hour and ten-hour shifts. - During winter, you ll work ten-hour shifts only. - Working hours are averaged over the year, and you ll be paid for 37.5 hours each week. - Shift times vary between 6:00am and 10:00pm. - Rotas are provided in advance. - A free taxi service is available for 6:00am starts and 10:00pm finishes. - You will receive mandatory digital training before your start date, which must be completed in full before you join. Your first week will consist of essential training, Monday to Friday, from 9:30am to 4:30pm. Attendance for the full duration of every training day and completion of all training are requirements of the role. This five-day training week is separate from your usual four-day working pattern. The training dates and hours are fixed and non-negotiable. We cannot accommodate holidays, routine appointments or other planned personal commitments during these sessions. Please apply only if you can commit to the full training programme. Failure to attend or complete mandatory training may result in your employment being terminated, subject to applicable statutory rights and any reasonable adjustments required by law. You ll need to engage fully with the learning, ask questions and demonstrate that you can pick up new information and processes quickly.

title: Customer Service Representative
description: About the role Serving our customers, communities, and planet a little better every day. Customer Service Representative Salary: 25,200 - 26,000 per year (depending on experience) + annual bonus Hours: Full-time, 36 hours per week Location: Longbenton, Newcastle About the role We know insurance is personal - that's why our colleagues in the General Insurance team know how to help Tesco customers with their home and motor insurance needs. As part of the team, you'll help customers manage and service their policies. You'll thrive in a fast-paced, professional team where working together to achieve what matters most goes hand in hand with delivering exceptional service with empathy and care. What you'll be responsible for - Delivering excellent customer service across every interaction - Managing high call volumes while maintaining a positive, engaging approach - Educating customers about our full range of products and services (training provided) - Handling inbound and occasional outbound calls - Applying judgement to resolve customer queries efficiently - Promoting our digital channels to help customers self-serve where appropriate - Recording all customer interactions accurately and promptly What you'll need - A passion for delivering excellent customer experiences - Previous contact centre experience is desirable, but transferable experience from retail, hospitality or leisure is equally valued - Clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal - Strong technical capability, as you'll regularly use multiple systems simultaneously - Empathy, resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced environment What's in it for you? - Tesco Colleague Clubcard: 10% discount (15% every payday weekend) - Wellbeing & health: free 24/7 Virtual GP service for you and your family, plus Cycle to Work scheme, and access to Wellhub to save on your gym membership - Generous leave: 7.2 weeks' holiday (including Bank Holidays) - Family support: enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave policies - Exclusive offers from top brands and partners - Financial security: pension scheme matching up to 7.5%, plus life assurance up to 5x salary By the way, we know it's important to balance work with everyday life commitments, so talk to us about any flexibility you need at interview. We're happy to explore part-time and flexible working opportunities across our business. Where you'll be working You'll begin your journey with onsite training in our Longbenton office before moving into your team. Our 'Moments that Matter' working model means you can request to work primarily from home once you're fully trained and competent. You'll still join your colleagues in the office for important team meetings, training and social events. The site is easy to reach by Metro and major bus routes, with free parking available. Important information As this is an FCA-regulated financial services role, all offers of employment are subject to background screening, including criminal record and financial checks. You must have the right to work in the UK (through nationality, visa or work permit). What happens next? Click apply and complete a short online application. If your experience is a good match, a member of our recruitment team will be in touch to talk through the role and next steps, and we'll keep you updated throughout the process. Why Tesco Insurance and Money Services? Seeing your impact all around you: there's no better feeling. Lucky for us, we get to feel it all the time. Because whatever our role, we're helping our colleagues and serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. We deal in the personal - from pet insurance for your best friend, and home insurance for peace of mind, to motor insurance for your dream car or travel money for that trip you've worked hard for. Everything we do is about making things better. Not just for others, but for you too. It's why you'll get bags of choice and plenty of development. It's why you'll always be heard and find balance that works for you. It's why you'll feel totally at home in a place where everyone's welcome. So, if you want a career where you can do good and feel good, you've found it. Let's make everyday a little better. Our story Making Insurance and Money Services more rewarding and offering great value and choice - because we know little wins can make a big difference. We began life in 1997 and now help more than 2 million customers protect what matters to them. We want to deliver a helpful service in everything we do and to make life easier for our customers. Our policies are really easy to manage online for our customers, but we know that being able to speak to our customer service staff when you need to is really important. This is why our customer service centers are open seven days a week. Delivering great customer service means having great people behind the scenes - people who understand our customers and are driven by doing the right thing for them. We offer colleagues a place where they can feel totally at home in a place where everyone's welcome, where they can be part of a great team focused on making a real difference for our customers. How to apply We value our people and diverse teams and believe the variety of backgrounds and experiences make us stronger to achieve our goals. Our colleagues are working hybrid, taking time to meet with colleagues in our offices for moments that matter, such as team catch ups, planning meetings and more. If you're interested in finding out more about what a career at Tesco Insurance and Money Services looks like, click apply to find out more!

title: Customer Service Administrator
description: Rewards & Benefits on Offer; - Immediate start date available - Permanent opportunity after successful 12 weeks - Competitive salary - Monday - Friday working hours - Friendly and supportive working environment - Easily accessible offices Working Hours; - Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm The Company you will be working with; MTrec Commercial are proudly representing our prestigious client on their search to appoint an experienced Customer Service Administrator to join their customer services team. This pivotal role requires strong focus on ensuring access and supply of our products with a high service standard. For a customer portfolio, you will be the key actor of all customer-facing operations, ensuring that every interaction is seamless, efficient and customer centric. If you have the required skills and experience, then please apply for an immediate response. The Role you will be doing; - Data processing: Receive, process, and manage customer orders accurately and efficiently, including order entry, verification, and confirmation. - Internal/External Communication: Assist and provide accurate information to customers regarding products, services, pricing, policies, and procedures, addressing any questions or uncertainties to ensure clarity and understanding. Liaise regularly with Warehouse, Planning, Quality Lab and any other relevant departments to ensure on time deliveries. - Issue Resolution: Investigate and resolve customer complaints or issues effectively, employing problem-solving skills, empathy, and diplomacy to achieve satisfactory outcomes and maintain positive customer relationships. - Documentation and Recordkeeping: Maintain comprehensive and organized records of customer interactions, transactions, inquiries, and resolutions using designated systems, ensuring data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with privacy regulations. - Order Processing: Monitor the status of orders throughout the fulfillment process, liaising with relevant departments to ensure orders reach customers within specified timeframes. Consolidate, monitor and analyse any KPI's (such as On Time Delivery, etc ) - Process Improvement: Analyze feedback from customers regarding their experiences, preferences, and suggestions, actively listening and taking part of continuous improvement and service enhancement. Take an active part in any process improvments or in creating/updating process documentation as needed. - Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with internal departments such as sales, operations, finance and IT to address customer needs, resolve issues, and facilitate seamless communication and workflow. - Invoice & Billing Support: Support any statements or documents clarification upon customer request. Analyse and solve any discrepencies to support orders, terms, and pricing agreements. - Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks documents and data entries to identify errors, discrepancies, or irregularities, and take corrective actions to resolve issues and prevent recurrence. - Training and Development: Take training courses to enhance the skills, knowledge, and performance of front office staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. - Presentation Skills: Ability to present a business subject with the needed structure or related tools (MS Office), to internal employees or customers. - Perform any other duties deemed relevant to the position About You; - Resilient, adaptable and results driven - Able to learn new activities or business (incl. basic technical or industrial data) - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, ability to prioritise. - Good communication with ability to convey information professionally to diverse audiences - Customer-first mindset, both internally and externally - Strong interpersonal skills, including empathy, patience, and tact - Drive change, work on own initiative - Promote teamwork - Keen attention to detail

title: Call Centre Agent
description: Where: BT Customer Contact Centre, Gosforth Park Way, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE12 8 ET Full time: Permanent Salary: £26,116 rising to £26.738 after 8 months of being here, plus incentives and bonuses Start date: January 2027 Shifts: 12 hour shifts on a two week rotation. Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday 08:30-21:00 08:45-21:00 OFF OFF OFF 08:00-20:00 08:00-20:00 OFF OFF 08:45-21:00 08:45-21:00 08:45-21:00 OFF OFF If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE. Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash. Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here. What does being a sales advisor involve? You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell. You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product. Forget what you've heard about sales Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths - Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work. - It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems. - People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console? Why you'll be better off at EE GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months. UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn. BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year. GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT. FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family. GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Customer Service Representative
description: The Rewards and Benefits on Offer: - Immediate start available - A competitive basic salary and benefits - 25 days holiday plus BHOLS - Death in Service 2x annual salary - Auto-enrolment pension - Healthcare cash plan. - The chance to gain experience with a rapidly growing blue-chip employer - Free on-site parking MTrec's New Opportunity: MTrec Recruitment are proudly representing our specialist manufacturing client in their recruitment for a Customer Service Representative. The main focus of the role is to work closely with sales and production teams to create a customer-friendly environment, with the expectation that you are responsible, service-minded and dedicated to providing high-quality service to customers If you meet the person specification below, apply now for an immediate response! The Job you will do: - Providing a highly efficient, service-oriented order fulfilment process for both internal and external sales, including order acceptance; transportation booking/scheduling; shipment documentation provision, in line with customer requirements - Proactively respond to customer queries e.g. order status, order amendments, thereby ensuring a high level of customer service - Monitor customer account and/or order status regularly, resolving problems with potential customer impact e.g. credit blocks, delivery issues - Control the delivery process, preparing associated documentation for goods despatch, booking transportation and agreed lead times - Maintain system housekeeping and admin About you: - Experience in a customer service-focused role, ideally within engineering/manufacturing - Experience in logistics and export documentation is desirable - Experience of handling difficult customers with tact and diplomacy and managing solutions to a satisfactory end for customer. - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including a confident and professional telephone manner. - The ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently when required. - Good IT literacy, with knowledge of common Microsoft Office applications
